module_name: Multimodal Analytics: Images, Video, Audio, OCR, Video LLMs
module_description: Module 15 handles the non-text majority of social content: image and video models (CLIP, SigLIP, ViT), OCR for on-screen text, automatic speech transcription (Whisper and derivatives) for TikTok/Reels/Shorts, and video LLMs for scene and action description. Students learn to align modalities (post text + video + audio) and to evaluate transcription accuracy on accented/colloquial Indonesian audio.
learning_outcomes: C3 Transcribe and OCR a short-video dataset
C4 Build a zero-shot image or video classifier for a domain
C5 Evaluate transcription/OCR error rates on local-language content
methods_models: Whisper/pykeformer transcription (word error rate), OCR (Tesseract/PaddleOCR/EasyOCR), CLIP zero-shot image classification, video frame sampling, multimodal fusion
evaluation_metrics: WER (word error rate), CER for Indonesian OCR, image classification precision/recall, human rating of descriptions
pitfalls_limitations: ASR errors on slang/accented Indonesian; OCR on stylized overlays; frame-sampling bias; modality disagreement counted as noise
tools_stack: openai-whisper / faster-whisper, transformers, CLIP/SigLIP, easyocr, tesseract, ffmpeg, yt-dlp
commercial_platforms: Commercial transcription/vision APIs compared for Indonesian accuracy
tools_access_cost: ASR/vision APIs priced per minute/minute; local Whisper free with GPU
lab_activities: Transcribe 50 short videos, OCR sample frames, build a searchable video index for one brand campaign
datasets_apis: Short-video sample from TikTok/YouTube on a topic; image corpus from a hashtag
assessment_methods: Lab notebook submission plus a 1-page interpretation with error analysis; graded on correctness, interpretation and documentation
data_collection_workflow: Collect posts -> clean text -> build annotation/codebook (human + LLM) -> validate with kappa -> train/evaluate -> archive labelled data and prompts
textbooks: Jurafsky & Martin, Speech and Language Processing, ch. on speech
key_papers: MDPI 2026 SMATM (multi-modal social account topic modeling)
2024-2026 papers on video/audio LLMs for social video understanding
trends_2024_2026: 2024-2026: short video made video+audio OCR analysis a first-class analytics task; multimodal models dropped cost and code complexity enough for student labs
industry_relevance: Core competency for social-listening analyst, insights researcher and content-strategy roles; employers (Pulsar, Talkwalker, Meltwater, Brandwatch) list sentiment/topic extraction as the default screening task for junior analysts.
localization_context: Indonesia-specific models and lexicons (IndoBERT family, NusaBERT, InSet) plus local datasets (Indonesian sentiment/emotion/hoax sets) are used as the primary lab material, because English-oriented models underperform on code-mixed colloquial Indonesian.
ethics_regulation: Annotation labor and consent, model reporting of error rates, and disclosure that automated affective labels on individuals can misrepresent them; UU PDP applies when the corpus contains identifiable user text.
case_study_scenarios: Analyze the visual and spoken content of a TikTok campaign and compare it with the written claims.
deliverable_format: Transcription + OCR dataset + multimodal index + findings memo
